text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Traveling Morioka
Festival.
Yukino Bijin invites me to come,
and I arrive to
find Gold City and Curren
Chan already here.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for com'n, everyone! Let's
have heaps
and heaps of fun today!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we'll be cheering for you. I gotta
say, this
space is much bigger than I
expected.
choice_data_list: さんさ太鼓、頑張ってな
さんさ太鼓、頑張ってね

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, it is pretty big, come to think of
it... It
looks like they put in a lot of work
to prepare for
my big day...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Take a deep breath, Yukino. You've put
in so
much practice. You'll be fi—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Screeeeeech!

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Oh no! The speakers!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, technical difficulties? Yikes.
Aw,
man. Wanna go somewhere else?

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Argh! Oh no... All our efforts're gonna
go t'waste!

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... And after you work'd so hard,
Yukino... It's
all my fault... I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hey...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! We're gonna be A-OK,
even if we
don't have a big fancy stage
or work'n speakers.

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: B-but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Both our belov'd Morioka and the sansa
odori are
meant to be enjoyed without
anyth'n fancy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what I'm sayin' is... you're in good
hands!
Leave the rest to me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm a bundle of nerves, but...
here goes
noth'n!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Da-dum! Da-da-dum! Clack, clack!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sakkora! Choiwa yasse!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
Is that the sound of taiko drums?
What's
this? Traveling Morioka Festival? Sounds

interesting!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, City. I've got a great idea on how
to hype
this up further! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Funny you say that. I have an idea as
well.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I-isn't that Gold City and Curren
Chan?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sakkora choiwa! ☆ Yasse! ♪

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: She's so cuuute! I wanna try!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Join in. You can just copy us as best you
can.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(G-Gold City and Curren Chan! And
even the
trainer! A-all right... I gotta go
even harder!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: O-okay, ev'ryone! Aaalllll togeth'r now!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Jinkies! Business was a-boom'n, thanks
to you!
Thanks a million!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No thanks nec'ssary! All I did was lose
mys'lf in
the taiko drum. You should be
thank'n City and
th'others for danc'n.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? Without
your
drumming, the whole thing
would've be a
non-starter.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You were so cute playing the taiko
drums that
everyone just wanted to
cheer you on! ♪
choice_data_list: ああ、君が頑張っていたからだ
うん、貴方が頑張っていたからだよ

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
You can say that again. Ev'ryone went
along with
you b'cause you never gave
up.

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
We had a picture perf'ct ending. And it's
all
thanks t'you. You worked hard'r than
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-you're all too kind!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Ehehe! Thank you all... so much...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Phew, sorry about that! I was bawl'n like
a baby
back there! But I'm fine now!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Well, shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, I had a close call today.
Yet again,
you nearly took my breath
away completely.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yet again?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I'm saying you're more incredible than
you give
yourself credit for.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Uhhh.. huh? City...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, you three! Hurry up or you'll be
left
behind! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Okay! Coming!
